---
description: Row for the responsive table-like list
title: Table row
---
`bcgov-table-row` is required for each row in a `bcgov-table`. It provides the responsive row layout, primary-column styling, and stacked-layout column labels. Add the `header` attribute to the header row; its cell text is used as labels on each data row.

See the [`bcgov-table` example](../bcgov-table/readme.md) for complete markup.

<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Properties

| Property | Attribute | Description                                     | Type      | Default     |
| -------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------- | --------- | ----------- |
| `header` | `header`  | Indicates whether this row is the table header. | `boolean` | `undefined` |
